title: EuAuAl$_{4}$(Au$_{1-x}$Ge$_{x}$)$_{2}$ Structure
comments:
Like \href{current_web_home_dir/A4BCD2_hR8_166_2c_a_b_c-001}{CeAuAl$_{4}$Ge$_{2}$}, the rare earth atoms in this structure have a complex antiferromagnetic ordering at low temperatures (Feng, 2024). 
 The site we label ``Ge'' actually has the composition Ge$_{0.59}$Au$_{0.41}$.
